label: Opening Hook
text: In 1963, a man renovating his house in Cappadocia knocked through a wall and found a tunnel.
title: File:Saint Theodore Church Derinkuyu Front Entrance.jpg

label: Terrain & Scale
text: It led into Derinkuyu, an underground city carved roughly 280 feet (85 m) down into soft volcanic rock.
title: File:Derinkuyu Underground City, Nevşehir Province, Turkey - panoramio.jpg

label: Inner Structure
text: Its levels held stables, wells, chapels and food stores, while dozens of ventilation shafts carried fresh air to the deepest rooms.
title: File:DerinkuyuKirche.jpg

label: Physical Evidence
text: Rolling stone doors, some weighing up to half a ton, sealed each level from the inside.
title: File:DerinkuyuKircheInnen.jpg
